|lore=Wookiee '''smuggler''' from Kashyyyk. Over 200 years old. Top-notch mechanic and pilot. Jabba has large bounty on this “walking carpet.” Friends call him Chewie… or Fuzzball.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During your turn, may use 1 Force to take a card with “Chewie” or “Wookiee” in game text into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

|notes=The 2006 slip uses the singular ‘a card’ for the Chewie or Wookiee take during your turn. The [[Chewbacca (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Original)|original-edition slip]] survives in the consolidated PDF made in February 2003. The sheet gives 20 September 2002 as the set’s tournament-legality date, and the complete set was available by 21 September. The [[Chewbacca (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=21 Period One Rule, p. 21].
